description: Restore a checkpoint into the remote workspace after comparing its current revision. Saves a safety checkpoint first; does not rewind external GitHub actions.

expectedRevision.description: Exact revision returned by the changes or checkpoint read.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

name: anyforge_restore_studio_checkpoint
title: Restore studio checkpoint
